name: G.L.A.Z.A
source:
Man, suffering from halutinations, do his best living casual live in megapolice. Despite his problems, he is quite successful, although he is closed due to troubles with his head.He catches the eye of an advertisement of a certain doctor presenting a revolutionary technology for the diagnosis and treatment of the psyche "G.L.A.Z.A.". The hero hesitates a little and decides to take a chance to dig into his problem and get rid of the need to drink pills. It turns out that yes, it's true, everything is like in advertising, but first you need to go through a thorough analysis, for this you will have to dive into the mind and understand the causes of the problem. Darkness, monsters, ghosts of the past and a cheerful girl guide will help the main character along the way, but only so that he understands the depth and breadth of his own despair.

[From [url=https://srandom.itch.io/glaza]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个饱受幻觉困扰的男人，努力在大都市中过着平常的生活。尽管有这些问题，他仍算事业有成，只是精神上的困扰让他变得封闭。某位医生宣传革命性心理诊疗技术“G.L.A.Z.A.”的广告吸引了他的目光。稍作犹豫后，他决定冒一次险，深入探究自身的问题，摆脱对药物的依赖。事实证明，一切确实如广告所言，但首先必须进行彻底的分析：他需要潜入自己的意识，查清问题的根源。黑暗、怪物、过去的幽灵，以及一位开朗的少女向导，将一路“帮助”他，却只是为了让他看清，自己的绝望究竟有多深、多广。

[摘自[url=https://srandom.itch.io/glaza]itch.io[/url]]
